description: This file is a SvelteKit server-side load and action module for managing account data via a Django API. It contains logic for fetching, transforming, creating, updating, activating/deactivating, and deleting account records, as well as handling related entities and filters.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches account data from the Django REST API, applies filtering and pagination, transforms data for frontend use, and retrieves supplementary options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new account, parsing form data, sending POST request to the API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing account via PATCH request, parsing form data for account ID and fields.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates an account by setting 'is_active' to false via PATCH.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Reactivates an account by setting 'is_active' to true via PATCH.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an account via DELETE request.
